title.context: Income screen title, also the Insights link to it.

add.context: Income screen: button in the header that opens the pad for logging income.

range12.context: Income screen: range choice, the last 12 months.

range24.context: Income screen: range choice, the last 24 months.

rangeAll.context: Income screen: range choice, everything logged.

loadFailed.context: Income screen: shown when loading fails; {error} is the technical message.

empty.message: No income logged in this range. Add one with the button above.
empty.context: Income screen: shown when the range has no income.

averagePay.context: Income screen: tile and table label, average monthly pay.

last12.context: Income screen: note under the average pay tile.

yearOnYear.context: Income screen: tile label, change of average pay vs the 12 months before.

versus.context: Income screen: note under the year-on-year tile; {amount} is the average pay the 12 months before.

noYearBefore.message: not a year of history yet
noYearBefore.context: Income screen: note under the year-on-year tile without enough history.

total.context: Income screen: tile label, all income in the range.

withOneOffs.context: Income screen: note under the total tile; {amount} is the one-off income in the range.

best.context: Income screen: tile label, the month with the most pay.

trendUp.message: Pay is {percent}% up on a year before: {recent} a month against {before}.
trendUp.context: Income screen chart headline; amounts with currency. Keep the <b> tags.

trendDown.message: Pay is {percent}% down on a year before: {recent} a month against {before}.
trendDown.context: Income screen chart headline; amounts with currency. Keep the <b> tags.

trendNone.message: Once there's a year of pay before the last one, this says whether it's going up.
trendNone.context: Income screen chart headline without enough history.

averageLine.context: Income screen: legend and reference line label, average pay.

pay.context: Income screen: tooltip and table label for pay (not one-offs).

oneOff.context: Income screen: tooltip and table label for one-off income.

monthsNote.message: Pay only: one-offs, like something sold, are counted apart. A month counts where its pay is for.
monthsNote.context: Income screen: note under the month-by-month chart.

peopleTitle.context: Income screen: chart title, income per person per month.

yearsTitle.context: Income screen: chart title, average monthly pay per calendar year.

yearsNote.message: The average month with pay, so a year that's just begun compares fairly.
yearsNote.context: Income screen: note under the year-by-year chart.

listHelp.message: Tap one to change or delete it.
listHelp.context: Income screen: help under the list title.

linkTrend.message: Pay {amount} a month, {change} year on year
linkTrend.context: Insights: line under the 'Money in' link; {amount} average pay, {change} a signed percentage like '+12%'.

linkAverage.context: Insights: line under the 'Money in' link; {amount} average pay.

linkEmpty.message: Every income, how pay is changing
linkEmpty.context: Insights: line under the 'Money in' link with no income yet.
